query: what do you call someone who writes biographies?
passage: Technically, if you write a book on someone’s life, it is called a biography, while if you write this biography yourself, i.e., you write an account of your own life in a book, it is called an autobiography. A bio, however, can be as small as 300 words, used as reference in a personal profile, in a professional bio-data, for business propositions, resumes, and other such public knowledge purposes.
